title: LInstRow
html:
定义组：指标替换与规约。有序参数：z903、z904、z905。

删除一个绑定并替入 s；命中指标 c 时插入 shift(0,c,s)。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ LInstRow z903 z904 z905) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists c
  (exists s
    (exists t
      (exists u
        (and
          (exists z908 (and (exists z909 (and (@ Pair t u z909) (@ Pair s z909 z908))) (@ Pair c z908 z905)))
          (and
            (@ Nat c)
            (and
              (@ AnyRaw s)
              (and
                (@ AnyRaw t)
                (or
                  (exists z910
                    (and
                      (@ TVar z910 t)
                      (or
                        (and (in z910 c) (= u t))
                        (or
                          (exists z912 (and (= z910 c) (and (@ Num0 z912) (@ LShift z912 c s u))))
                          (exists z911 (and (in c z910) (and (@ Succ z911 z910) (@ TVar z911 u))))))))
                  (or
                    (exists z910 (and (@ TConst z910 t) (= t u)))
                    (or
                      (exists z914
                        (exists z915
                          (exists z920
                            (and
                            (@ ULam z914 t)
                            (and
                            (@ ULam z915 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Succ c z920)
                            (exists z921
                            (exists z922
                            (and
                            (in z921 z904)
                            (and
                            (@ App z903 z921 z922)
                            (exists z923
                            (and (exists z924 (and (@ Pair z914 z915 z924) (@ Pair s z924 z923))) (@ Pair z920 z923 z922)))))))))))))
                      (or
                        (exists z913
                          (exists z914
                            (exists z915
                            (exists z920
                            (and
                            (@ TLam z913 z914 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TLam z913 z915 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Succ c z920)
                            (exists z925
                            (exists z926
                            (and
                            (in z925 z904)
                            (and
                            (@ App z903 z925 z926)
                            (exists z927
                            (and (exists z928 (and (@ Pair z914 z915 z928) (@ Pair s z928 z927))) (@ Pair z920 z927 z926))))))))))))))
                        (exists z916
                          (exists z917
                            (exists z918
                            (exists z919
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z916 z917 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z918 z919 u)
                            (and
                            (exists z929
                            (exists z930
                            (and
                            (in z929 z904)
                            (and
                            (@ App z903 z929 z930)
                            (exists z931
                            (and (exists z932 (and (@ Pair z916 z918 z932) (@ Pair s z932 z931))) (@ Pair c z931 z930)))))))
                            (exists z933
                            (exists z934
                            (and
                            (in z933 z904)
                            (and
                            (@ App z903 z933 z934)
                            (exists z935
                            (and (exists z936 (and (@ Pair z917 z919 z936) (@ Pair s z936 z935))) (@ Pair c z935 z934))))))))))))))))))))))))))

直接依赖

AnyRaw；App；LShift；Nat；Num0；Pair；Succ；TApp；TConst；TLam；TVar；ULam
